scope: slice 7 practice-flow frontend (implement-practice-flow-ui): child HQ, mission briefing, task screen (attempts, reveal, UNPARSEABLE, hints, translation toggle, report a problem, save and resume), client-side navigation, the child contract stub

findings.title: Submit applies the server result to a stale `task`, so a hint or translation that arrives during the request is lost
Translation toggle shows 'failed' and a mismatched state when the setting saved but the task re-read failed
A revealed typed part still shows the child's wrong answer in the read-only field, and a reload shows it empty
The report note's `maxLength` counts UTF-16 units while the clamp and contract count code points
A 409 'no hint left' leaves the hint count stale, with only a generic error
HQ and the mission briefing first render cached progress and continue targets from before the last answer
Coverage summary: 14 delta scenarios (14 implemented, 0 partial, 0 missing, 0 contradicted); the store-level frontend scenarios also hold, except that NFR-5 was not measured
Focus is lost when the last hint opens and the hint button becomes disabled (NFR-7 focus management)
The revealed part keeps the child's wrong value as the prominent input text; the correct answer appears only as a small muted caption
The report note limit uses `maxLength` (UTF-16 units) next to a code-point clamp, so notes with emoji stop below 1000 characters
Some error and fallback UI has no backing requirement: hint and translation failure alerts, load retry, any non-404/409 error reported as a save failure
Attempt pips show the opposite of their label: filled = attempts left, text = attempts used
The revealed answer for 'round 7,04 to tenths' shows '7', not '7,0'
After resume, an empty field shows the orange 'Zkus znovu' state
Report note error is styled like plain body text and sits away from the field
400/413 responses to submitAttempt are shown as a lost response and trigger resync
NFR-5 (1.5 s task load, 300 ms p95 check round trip) is never measured, yet task 4.1 is ticked with 'Overall result: Pass'
